title: Day 781: Gunmen Torch Three Vehicles Beside Apartment Building in Colonia Seis de Enero; 18 Evacuated
detail: Around 1:00 AM on Saturday, September 12, 2026, an armed group opened fire on two Toyota Hilux pickups and a Volkswagen Jetta parked at the corner of Calle Profesora Concepción Ocaranza and Avenida Teniente Juan de la Barrera in the Seis de Enero neighborhood of Culiacán, then set the vehicles ablaze, along with a Honda parked nearby. Because the fire threatened an adjacent apartment building, firefighters evacuated 18 residents — including a minor and a pregnant woman — as a precaution. No injuries were reported. Firefighters extinguished the blaze before it reached the apartments; state investigative police processed the scene.

title: Day 781: Woman Killed as Gunmen Chase Red Pickup Near Infonavit Humaya Overpass
detail: During the afternoon of Saturday, September 12, 2026, armed subjects pursued a red Ford Ranger pickup truck along Boulevard José Limón — the Culiacán–Los Mochis international highway — near the road distributor by Infonavit Humaya in northern Culiacán, firing repeatedly with long guns. The truck lost control, jumped the median and crashed into the overpass railing. Red Cross paramedics found the driver, believed to be a woman, dead inside the vehicle; her identity was not officially confirmed at the time of reporting. Mexican Army personnel and state investigators closed both lanes of the overpass while processing the scene. The killing was one of four homicides recorded in Culiacán that day, part of a wider wave of violence across Sinaloa state.

title: Day 781: Three More Bodies Found Across Culiacán — Lázaro Cárdenas, Tierra Blanca and Eldorado Highway
detail: Three additional bodies were found in separate locations across Culiacán on Saturday, September 12, 2026. In the Lázaro Cárdenas neighborhood, a man identified as José Luis 'N' was found wrapped in transparent plastic with gunshot wounds near a vandalized property. In Tierra Blanca, a second man was found with his head covered in plastic; he had not been identified for lack of documents. On the Culiacán–Eldorado highway at the El Quemadito junction, a man was found dead with his hands bound. State investigative police processed each scene; no arrests were announced. The three deaths brought Culiacán's toll for the day to four, part of a wider wave of ten homicides recorded across Sinaloa state on the eve of a peace march marking two years of the Chapitos–Mayos war.

title: Day 781: Five Killed Across Mazatlán in Single Day — Pradera Dorada, Alamitos, Estero and Shumizu
detail: Mazatlán recorded five homicides on Saturday, September 12, 2026. At 5:15 AM, a man and a woman showing signs of violence, their faces covered with bags, were found on an overgrown property at Patos and Roble streets in Pradera Dorada III. At 2:25 PM, a 19-year-old identified as Rodolfo 'N' was shot dead inside a residence on Alamitos street. At around the same time, a 25-year-old man was killed and two others wounded in an armed attack on Río de las Cañas street in the Estero neighborhood. At approximately 4:30 PM, a man aged 45–50 was shot dead inside a home in the Shumizu neighborhood. The killings came as Mazatlán continues to absorb a growing share of the Chapitos–Mayos conflict under the Navy's 'Operación Sable' deployment.

title: Day 781: Woman's Body Found Alongside Highway Mexico 15 in Escuinapa
detail: On Saturday, September 12, 2026, motorists alerted authorities to a woman's body beside Highway Mexico 15 in the municipality of Escuinapa, southern Sinaloa. Her identity was not confirmed at the time of reporting. State investigative police and forensic personnel processed the scene. The death was the tenth homicide recorded across Sinaloa state that day, on the eve of a peace march in Culiacán marking two years since the start of the Chapitos–Mayos war.
